verdict.rationale: First-party docs say that once a goal or task is set, Muse keeps working on a schedule and in response to events, taking next steps and following up (muse-docs-20). It continues after the app is closed and sends notifications when something needs attention (muse-docs-26, muse-docs-24), and tasks are tracked in a Goals tab (muse-docs-5). missing for 10: explicit documentation of user-defined recurring vs one-off schedules (cadence/time controls), detail on how results are delivered beyond notifications, independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled runs.
